reason: Test value_tile=128 without unroll. With VD=128 benchmark shapes, a single 128-wide value tile means one program per head (no tile axis split), eliminating the redundant state reload per tile from the baseline's 64-tile. Keeps the original loop (no unroll) to avoid the UB overflow, so per-step branch control is unchanged. Hypothesis: fewer programs each doing a full [128,128] state update amortizes state loads; may help large-batch cases.
